mapper.select: select * from outbox_event where (status='PENDING' and next_attempt_at <= current_timestamp(3)) or (status='PROCESSING' and lease_until < current_timestamp(3)) order by id limit 100
mapper.update: update outbox_event set status='PROCESSING', lease_token=#{token}, lease_until=timestampadd(second,30,current_timestamp(3)), attempt_count=attempt_count+1,updated_at=current_timestamp(3) where id=#{id} and ((status='PENDING' and next_attempt_at <= current_timestamp(3)) or (status='PROCESSING' and lease_until < current_timestamp(3)))
